//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Current Game Music Track -> Config

Enable Current Game Music Track.//: Whether Current Game Music Track is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

durationTitleShownInTicks.//: How long the music track title should be visible on the screen. 20 ticks = 1 second. min: 0, max: 1,200

titleShouldFadeIn.//: Whether the music track title should fade in.

titleShouldFadeOut.//: Whether the music track title should fade out.

musicGUIPosition.//: Where the music GUI is shown at the bottom of the screen. options: Left, Center, Right

musicGUIBottomHeightOffset.//: The vertical offset (y coord) for the music GUI. This determines how far up the text should be on the screen. Can be changed to prevent GUIs from overlapping. min: 0, max: 3,000

musicGUIWidthOffset.//: The horizontal offset (x coord) for the music GUI. min: -3,000, max: 3,000

drawTextShadow.//: If the text displayed should have a shadow drawn below it.

RGB.//: The colour of the music GUI text, as red, green and blue values from 0 to 255.
